Metadata.title: WanasaBookMe — Host and join events
Metadata.description: Create events, split the cost fairly, and bring people together across the UAE and the Gulf.

Home.heroTitle: Bring people together, split the cost fairly
Home.heroSubtitle: Host an event, set a total budget, and watch the price per person drop as more friends join.
Home.step1Body: Book the venue, name your budget. You decide the total, not the ticket price.
Home.step2Body: Send it to your group on WhatsApp. Everyone sees the live price per person.
Home.step3Body: The more people who join, the less everyone pays. Nobody pays more than they agreed to.
